reviewer: flapjack-opus source comparison (bead flapjack-pxn.18.5.6.34.1.2): HOL Datatype behaviour = Diverge (io_event llist) | Terminate outcome (io_event list) | Fail (ffiScript.sml:89-101); Lean HolBehaviour.diverge (HolLList HolIoEvent) | .terminate (HolOutcome) (List HolIoEvent) | .fail, over the tagged io_event/outcome carriers. HOL's llist is rendered by Flapjack/Misc/LList.lean HolLList, which is HOL's own llist type definition (llistScript.sml:64: the subtype of num -> 'a option satisfying lrep_ok, stated via HOL's lrep_ok_alt characterisation), not a different representation; list is List. Same constructors, order and arguments; exact.
